# Douglas Rushkoff

> Author, documentarian, and professor of media theory studying human autonomy in the digital age. Host of the Team Human podcast.

## Pages
- [Home](https://rushkoff.com/): Overview of Douglas Rushkoff's work
- [About](https://rushkoff.com/about.html): Biography and background
- [Books](https://rushkoff.com/books.html): Books including Program or Be Programmed and Survival of the Richest
- [Films](https://rushkoff.com/films.html): Documentaries, including PBS Frontline's Merchants of Cool
- [Speaking](https://rushkoff.com/speaking.html): Keynotes (booked via The Lavin Agency)
- [Podcast](https://rushkoff.com/podcast/): The Team Human podcast
- [Press](https://rushkoff.com/press.html): Press and media coverage
- [Contact](https://rushkoff.com/contact.html): How to get in touch
- [Article archive](https://archive.rushkoff.com/): Searchable archive of articles
